comparison.objective: Orient and seat a filter cartridge according to its flow arrow; candidate finishes four installed inserts by removing tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Filter task tests marking interpretation, rotational orientation, and seating; candidate tests recessed coaxial alignment, hammer impact regulation, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Cartridge must sit flat with its arrow downstream; candidate requires four notch fractures, no retained-part damage, complete containment, and stable release.
comparison.reason: Orientation-aware insertion is mechanically and functionally different from contact-driven break-off and debris recovery.
